body.name: Background-oriented consistent-extension enumerator
body.construction: Form the ordinary CPDAG of \(G\), orient every arrow in \(F(C)\), apply closure under the standard consistent-extension rules, and enumerate every acyclic extension \(K\) with the same unshielded colliders. For each extension emit the unique lift \(E_K=(K,\Pi^K)\) with \[\Pi^K_j=\mathcal N_j(C)\cup\left\{\{a\}:a\in\operatorname{pa}_K(j)\setminus\bigcup\mathcal N_j(C)\right\},\qquad j\in V.\] The emitted set is \(\operatorname{Enum}(C)\).
